paper_cards.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
paper_cards.data: 4,856 QA pairs across 13 tasks from 1,646 real UAV videos (about 14.9 hours), sourced from AirScape, UrbanVideo-Bench, and VisDrone with dual-expert verification.
paper_cards.method: A self-in-space evaluation hierarchy spanning space/self and perception/memory/reasoning, plus SIS-Motion optical-flow feature fusion as a controlled motion-aware baseline.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate whether video MLLMs jointly model external 3D/spatiotemporal structure and the UAV's own motion/action state.
paper_cards.novelty: Makes agent self-state explicit alongside environmental spatial cognition in aerial embodied evaluation.
paper_cards.evidence: Official project, arXiv page, public GitHub and Hugging Face dataset agree on task count, data scale, protocol, and model coverage.

claim_checks.notes: Official project and dataset card agree.
Official full results table is public.
Dataset card links evaluation code and downloadable data.

paper_cards.limitations: UAV-only domain, multiple-choice evaluation, and source datasets constrain transfer beyond aerial settings.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Provides explicit AgentState, MotionHistory, SpatialMemory, ActionPrediction, and PathPlanning evaluation fields.

paper_cards.title: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
paper_cards.data: RBench has 650 image-text cases across five task types and four embodiments; RoVid-X has 4M annotated 720p clips over 1,300+ skills aggregated from 20+ public sources.
paper_cards.method: Nine-indicator embodied video evaluation covering task/embodiment dimensions, paired with a four-stage collection, filtering, segmentation, and annotation pipeline for robot video training data.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate task correctness, physical plausibility, action completeness, and visual fidelity of robot-oriented video generators, and provide data to train them.
paper_cards.novelty: Couples a reproducible embodied video benchmark with a large multi-embodiment, physically annotated training corpus and public leaderboard.
paper_cards.evidence: ICML/OpenReview paper, official project, benchmark/data links, leaderboard, qualitative comparisons, and demo video were inspected.

claim_checks.claim: 650 cases, five tasks, four robot types, 25 models

claim_checks.notes: Author-reported paper result; not independently reproduced.

paper_cards.limitations: Aggregated public datasets may inherit licensing/domain biases; ByteDance-affiliated authors evaluate Seedance; metrics and scale claims remain author-reported.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct evaluator and data-source reference for generated physical-world consistency and action-aligned video.

paper_cards.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
paper_cards.data: Egocentric video and robot-control data with RoboTwin2.0 and RMBench evaluations, as reported by the paper.
paper_cards.method: Autoregressive backbone with World and Action experts that predicts semantic intentions, subgoal imagery, and actions; world prediction can be enabled for test-time scaling.
paper_cards.task: Unified long-horizon language reasoning, world prediction, and robot action synthesis.
paper_cards.novelty: Joins semantic subtask generation and fine-grained physical dynamics in a single causal world-language-action model.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary arXiv abstract and paper support architecture and reported metrics; no sufficiently inspectable official demo/project surface was located.
paper_cards.limitations: No public release verified and physical demo diversity/failure behavior could not be judged confidently.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct world-action architecture reference, pending human visual review.
